jm179.title: Japanese Monograph No. 179: China Area Operations Record (Central China)
jm179.publisher: Headquarters, U.S. Army Forces Far East／Military History Section（HyperWar 轉錄）
jm179.gradeBasis: 官方戰史原件經第三方轉錄本，A 記 B

body.zh-Hant: 日本陸軍中將朝香宮鳩彥王被任命為上海派遣軍司令官。同一份戰史註記說明，中支那方面軍於1937年11月7日臨時編成，用以統轄上海派遣軍等部隊。
body.en: Lt Gen Prince Yasuhiko Asaka was appointed commander of the Shanghai Expeditionary Army. The same monograph note says the Central China Area Army was organized temporarily on 7 November 1937 to control the Shanghai Expeditionary Army, among other forces.
